title: Return to the footbridge
steps: Stand at the same safe public viewpoint.
Describe water color and visible clarity without guessing its contents.
Record time and recent rain; take a comparison photo if safe.
how_to_record: Place, time, rain context, clarity description, and observation effort.
safety_note: Stay on the public path. Do not enter water, lean over barriers, or infer drinking safety.

title: Check the drainage view
steps: Return to a safe public viewpoint near the culvert.
Photograph the opening without approaching flowing water.
Note visible obstructions and what you cannot see.
how_to_record: Repeat viewpoint, date, recent rain, visible obstruction description.
safety_note: No trespass, no entering culverts, no clearing debris. Skip the visit during flooding.

title: Ten minutes with the flowers
steps: Choose a flower patch accessible from public or own property.
Watch for ten minutes without disturbing visitors.
Count visits; record unknown identities as unknown.
how_to_record: Minutes watched, visit count, flower description, weather, place.
safety_note: Do not handle insects, disturb nests, or enter protected planting areas.

title: Compare sun and shade
steps: Choose adjacent public shaded and sunny viewpoints.
Describe surfaces and shade at the same time.
If using a thermometer, use the same setup and wait for readings to settle.
how_to_record: Paired descriptions, time, instrument or 'no instrument', and units if measured.
safety_note: Avoid traffic and extreme heat. Stay hydrated; do not use this as a health assessment.

title: Meet your planter again
steps: Visit your own planter.
Describe the surface as dry, damp, or wet without disturbing roots.
Record roof cover, watering, and a photo.
how_to_record: Same planter, time, surface description, cover, last known watering.
safety_note: Own property only. Avoid unknown soil or contaminants and wash hands afterward.

title: Make a plant reference photo
steps: Choose a safe repeatable public viewpoint.
Photograph plant coverage using the same fence section as reference.
Leave the identification unconfirmed unless verified.
how_to_record: Date, viewpoint, coverage description, identification confidence.
safety_note: Do not remove plants or touch unknown species; no collecting in protected areas.

title: A quiet bird count
steps: Stand quietly on a public path.
Count birds for ten minutes, avoiding double counts where possible.
Record unknown species as unknown and note your uncertainty.
how_to_record: Count, duration, location words, weather, uncertain identifications.
safety_note: Keep distance, do not feed birds, approach nests, or handle wildlife.

title: Notice visible litter
steps: Observe a short stretch from the public path.
Record visible litter types without touching them.
Mark anything you cannot identify as unknown.
how_to_record: Visible items, approximate stretch, time, and viewing limitations.
safety_note: Do not enter water or handle waste. Visible litter is not a microplastic measurement.

title: Notice the evening light
steps: Choose a familiar, safe public viewpoint at dusk.
Note lamp direction and surrounding shade.
Record wildlife only if observed; do not infer absence from no sightings.
how_to_record: Time, light direction, weather, viewing duration, sightings.
safety_note: Do not walk alone in unsafe conditions, shine lights at animals, or trespass.

title: Look up at the canopy
steps: Stop safely on a public footpath.
Describe overhead shade and nearby hard surfaces.
Take a repeatable photo without photographing identifiable people.
how_to_record: Place words, time, shade description, weather, viewpoint.
safety_note: Stop walking before looking up. Stay clear of roads and private property.
